language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Hi, I'm Oscar and I am on holiday. My parents took me on a cruise to see the North Pole. You see this big ship that I'm standing on? They call that a cruise ship!
The deck of this cruise ship is made of wood. Wood is made from trees!
These tables however are made from plastic. Plastic is man-made and not found in nature.
Let's see what else we can learn about materials. I'll show you around!
Hello, I am Tim.
Hi, I'm Oscar and I am on holiday. My parents took me on a cruise to see the North Pole. You see this big ship that I'm standing on? They call that a cruise ship!
The deck of this cruise ship is made of wood. Wood is made from trees!
These tables however are made from plastic. Plastic is man-made and not found in nature.
Let's see what else we can learn about materials. I'll show you around!
We are still on our way to the North Pole, but there is already so much to see! I saw forests and mountains on the coast. And in the middle of the sea, I saw a huge oil platform!

Tim tells me that some of the things I saw were natural materials. And some other things were made by humans from these natural materials. For example, the wood of a table is directly from nature. But the paper of a book is made from wood by people in a factory. Sometimes it is very difficult to see which is which, can you help me?

Look, this is where they collect all the garbage of this ship. They sort it out for recycling. This means that some materials will be used again. Recycling helps nature, because that way people won’t waste too much natural materials.
Can you help me sort?

We have now learned a lot about recycling. We recycle to make sure that we don’t run out of natural resources. Not all materials can be recycled, though. Do you know which objects are recyclable and
which are not?

helperSimple.text: One of the items is different from the rest; either it is the only one that is recyclable or it is the only one that is not recyclable. Click on the odd one out!

outro.text: Wow… you really know a lot about recycling, thanks!
